definitions.gloss: America; the United States; US (prefix/compound element)
definitions.explanation: The on'yomi reading of {米|べい} used as an abbreviated reference to the United States, derived from the historical transliteration {亜米利加|あめりか}. Mostly used in compounds, especially in news writing about US politics, military, and trade.

examples.japanese: {米軍|べいぐん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{基地|きち}→基地：03982_kichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}いている→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: The US military has a base there.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日米|にちべい}→日米：13092_nichibei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{首脳|しゅのう}→首脳：15631_shunou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{会談|かいだん}→会談：11542_kaidan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The leaders of Japan and the US held talks.

examples.japanese: {米中|べいちゅう}{貿易摩擦|ぼうえきまさつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えている→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: US-China trade friction is affecting the economy.

notes:
The kanji {米|べい} also has the kun'yomi reading こめ meaning 'rice' — context and compounding disambiguate. The 'America' sense appears almost exclusively as a prefix in compounds, especially in newspaper headlines where space is at a premium.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{米国|べいこく}→米国：19596_beikoku⟧: the United States
- {米軍|べいぐん}: the US military
- ⟦{日米|にちべい}→日米：13092_nichibei⟧: Japan and the US
- {米中|べいちゅう}: the US and China
- ⟦{訪米|ほうべい}→訪米：22848_houbei⟧: a visit to the US
- {駐米|ちゅうべい}: stationed in / posted to the US

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦アメリカ→アメリカ：01769_amerika⟧: America — the standard full-katakana form used in everyday speech
- ⟦{米国|べいこく}→米国：19596_beikoku⟧: the US — a single-word formal alternative

CROSS-REFERENCE:
- The 'rice' sense (⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧) is in entry 01323_kome.
